scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Intern
other_conditions: Student and his/her parents must belong to the Brahmin community
Parents should be staying in Andhra Pradesh
Student should have cleared CPT/Graduation before 2018, registered, and paid CA‑Inter (IPCC) exam fees
Student should not have benefitted from APBWC for the same exam (CA Inter / IPCC) earlier
Student must be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS)
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹20,000 for the CA Inter (IPCC) course.
